title: tACS for Patients with Post-Stroke Anomia
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from two chronic post-stroke patients with anomia (one left-hemisphere and one right-hemisphere lesion) who took part in an 8-week individualized transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) intervention. Stimulation and non-stimulation phases alternated every two weeks in a single-case ABAB design. EEG was recorded during a picture naming task across intervention and follow-up sessions to examine whether tACS improves naming accuracy and latency and whether the effects persist.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Starstim-32 system during a picture naming task using standardized stimuli. tACS frequency and montage were personalized from each participant's initial EEG profile. Sessions were recorded at weeks 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8 of the intervention and at follow-ups at weeks 12 and 20. Data were preprocessed in EEGLAB and converted to BIDS.
